experimental_method: In situ near-infrared absorption (7100-7500 cm-1 band) of water dissolved in scCO2 above liquid water or CaCl2 solution; solubility from the intersection of linear fits of absorbance versus added water volume (spectral titration).
uncertainties_stated: +/-10% of the value (triplicate measurements); T and P sensor accuracies not stated
quality_remarks: Authors note 100 C literature value of 2.7 mol% (Greenwood and Barnes) is disproportionately high. Saturated CaCl2 solutions were prepared at 25 C; higher-T concentrations undefined. Table 5 concentrations labelled M but Fig. 6 labels them molal. Temperature scale not stated.
